CTRP.split_design: 20 response-blind lineage-stratified identity-group holdouts. Approximately 80/20 per lineage, nearest feasible rounded sample count, at least one identity group on each side. Uniform random group subsets conditional on each sample-count target.
CTRP.inner_design: Five identity-group-stratified validation folds within outer training. A lineage represented by one training identity group is always inner training (-2) and never inner validation. Thus all 23 lineages remain in every inner training set; validation has 22 lineages because Ampulla has only one outer-training line.

PRISM.split_design: 20 response-blind lineage-stratified grouped holdouts. Within each lineage, sample intact identity groups uniformly among subsets with nearest feasible sample count to round(0.2*n), requiring at least one group in both training/testing. New masks generated on PRISM cohort, shared by all six arms.
PRISM.inner_design: Same five response-blind group-stratified inner folds per outer split across all six arms. Every inner training fit retains all 20 lineages; rare lineages cannot occur in every inner validation fold. If an outer-training lineage had one group it would remain protected in every inner training fit.
PRISM.target: Unchanged negative reported PRISM erastin AUC

weighting: Unweighted training. Fixed pretrained TabPFN configuration; no local gradient training.

settings.random_state: Original outer-split seed for each repeat

preprocessing: Input is unchanged 64-gene log RNA. No all-cohort scaling. Native feature/target preprocessing fit on outer-training rows only; predict transforms held-out features without fitting. Backbone train-context statistics exclude query rows, checked by query-neighbor invariance.
tuning: No study-specific hyperparameter, checkpoint, calibration or ensemble-weight tuning. Original inner-fold assignments are retained and audited but are not used for selection of this fixed model. Baseline nested tuning remains unchanged.
selection: CPU timing only selected 3.5-Fast over the slower v2 pilot. No pilot accuracy computed. Eight passes fixed before benchmark fits; no test-informed checkpoint or setting selection.
isolation: Separate venv for new dependencies; existing baseline analysis environment unchanged. Local checkpoint paths, offline HF mode, and network disabled during fit/predict.

uncertainty.unit: Paired bootstrap of whole lineages, retaining all models and overlapping repeats together. Conditional exploratory intervals; no independent-repeat test.

limitations: Repeatedly inspected cohorts/splits remain exploratory; confirmation on new data is required.
All evaluated lineages represented in training/testing; no unseen-lineage or patient claim.
Results apply to 3.5-Fast, this checkpoint and eight passes; not every TabPFN version or tuning strategy.
Pretraining-corpus overlap with these pharmacogenomic data has not been independently audited.
Original harmonized CTRP AUC generation provenance remains unresolved; no assay pooling or target changes.
